entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I assist you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for an order.
Certainly. I can help with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-881-92B. I just need to know if I can return this helmet or not. I'm a bit short on time.

I understand completely. Let me pull that up right now... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To make sure I process this correctly for you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference. The color just isn't what I expected. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.

Got it, thank you for clarifying. We definitely want you to be happy with your gear, especially something as important for safety as a helmet. Let me just confirm the return eligibility based on the delivery date.
Right. So, can I return it?

Yes, you can. I've checked the timeline, and you are well within our 90-day return period. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you. I just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account.
Okay, a label is on its way. That's what I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Just attach that label to the package and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund. Was there anything else for you today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
